categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: (1) Military products including military-grade pyrotechnic products (fire elements, fire devices), military training materials, and military meteorological rockets; (2) Civil products including weather modification equipment, meteorological observation and detection equipment, and related software. The company also extends into digital economy fields such as smart meteorology and smart environmental monitoring.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on pyrotechnic materials and manufacturing processes. Key technologies include: fire-working drug formulations (core technology), automated and intelligent production lines for pyrotechnic products, weather modification equipment manufacturing, and software development for meteorological applications. The company utilizes electronic technology, artificial intelligence, IoT, satellite positioning, and cloud computing in product development and technical transformation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include: (1) Military customers: various branches of the Chinese military (Army, Navy, Air Force, Rocket Force, Strategic Support Force) and public security/armed police; (2) Civil customers: meteorological departments across 20+ provinces and nearly 1,000 counties/districts in China; (3) End markets: military equipment manufacturers, weather modification agencies, and environmental monitoring organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China. Key operating regions include: Jiangxi Province (headquarters in Xinyu), with subsidiaries in Nanjing and Nanchang. The company has established cooperative relationships with meteorological departments across more than 20 provinces and autonomous regions in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at the midstream to downstream positions in the supply chain. For military products, it serves as a component supplier to military equipment manufacturers and integrators. For civil products, it manufactures and sells weather modification equipment and meteorological monitoring systems directly to end-users (meteorological departments and environmental agencies).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Developing fourth and fifth-generation pyrotechnic products to close technology gaps with advanced nations; (2) Transitioning from ground-based to air-based weather modification systems; (3) Advancing integrated, intelligent, and automated weather modification equipment; (4) Expanding into digital economy sectors including smart meteorology, smart environmental monitoring, and smart water management; (5) Strengthening R&D capabilities through collaboration with research institutions and universities.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through: (1) Direct sales of military pyrotechnic products and military training materials to military enterprises and equipment manufacturers; (2) Direct sales of weather modification equipment and meteorological monitoring equipment to provincial and local meteorological departments; (3) Software development and licensing services; (4) Engineering services and technical support. All sales utilize direct sales models without distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include: (1) In military pyrotechnic products: China North Industries Group (NORINCO) subsidiaries, China North Industries Group Equipment (CBIE) subsidiaries, and Long March Defense (now CBIE subsidiary); (2) In weather modification: China Aerospace Science and Technology Group's Zhongtian Rocket and NORINCO subsidiaries. The company ranks among the top in China's weather modification equipment market with significant market share and maintains important status in the military pyrotechnic industry as one of the most comprehensive domestic pyrotechnic product manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized defense technology enterprise with 2024 revenue of 445.08 million yuan (up 14.53% YoY) and net profit of 79.18 million yuan (up 4.56% YoY). Total assets reached 833.39 million yuan as of end-2024. The company demonstrates steady growth with consistent profitability, though growth rates have moderated in recent years.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Key differentiators include: (1) Comprehensive product portfolio covering complete weather modification system solutions (detection, operation, command, storage, management); (2) Advanced integrated weather modification command vehicles combining observation, command, and operation capabilities; (3) Strong R&D capabilities with 110+ active patents and continuous innovation in pyrotechnic materials; (4) Established relationships with 20+ provinces and nearly 1,000 counties; (5) Integration of information technology with traditional products through two-way fusion strategy; (6) Specialized expertise in both military and civil applications of pyrotechnic and weather modification technologies.
